hypothesis: Repeated agreement of the trusted tracker and a low-threshold shadow on the same current proposal permits a short causal continuation of the already published trusted identity during missing trusted outputs.
selection_rule: Only agreement3 cases; require last-quarter forward Train HOTA gain >=0.1 over the previously selected PP method and full Dev HOTA no lower than that PP method within1e-10. Rank validation HOTA, then Dev HOTA/AssA/IDF1 and identifier. Agreement1 is a fixed mechanism control. No Test reselection.
Test_cases_if_qualified: Previously selected PP reference and the newly Train/Dev-selected bridge case, complete Test7/15985. No strongestRGB or crossarchitecture sweep.
exposure: Historical Test was exposed, including previous PP results before this new hypothesis. Selection still uses only forward Train/Dev. Old encoders saw Train identities and older work inspected the development window. This is not a newly blinded test.
modality_scope: The bridge consumes only cached measured geometry, tracker identities and the old fixed paired gate. It creates no new IR-only signal, and a positive result alone cannot establish an independent multimodal innovation.
prior_work_boundary: Short-term object permanence, track continuation and identity handoff are established tracking ideas. This study tests a conservative implementation and its conditional contribution without claiming these ideas as new.
